csv_project_name: CMAR for Carver County Government Center Project
csv_scope_of_work: Carver County is requesting proposals from qualified Construction Management firms capable of providing Construction Manager at Risk (CM@R) professional pre-construction and construction management services. Carver County is in the process of developing plans and specifications for the re-envisioning of the existing Carver County government center located in Chaska, Minnesota. On the existing 13- acre parcel, five buildings currently exist. Two buildings will be demolished as part of the project, and replaced by the construction of an approximate 100,000 square foot government center building(s). In addition, about 30,000 square foot of government center space will be renovated.
